decisions.reason: The image-count clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the internal-link change requires no further image-state edit.
The existing publication condition already requires images and internal links before publication; refining link destinations does not necessarily change the publication requirement.
The source specifies blog images, internal-link destinations, and article length but does not change selected keywords or the keyword replacement rule.
The source does not change the workflow for proposing or selecting blog topics.
The source concerns requirements for blog articles and does not alter the webpage replacement text.
The source does not change the campaign keyword count, selected replacement keyword, or mapped page.
Internal links within blog articles are distinct from off-page backlink creation, and the source does not change backlink quantity or follow-type proportions.
